snippet.title: Elowyn: Quest of Time Trailer - Green Games Showcase | Summer Game Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Elowyn: Quest of Time by EARTHwise is a groundbreaking Play2Thrive card game where strategy meets real-world impact. Master win-win tactics, face high-stakes challenges, and help shape a thriving future—all while having fun!
Battle the cunning Moloch AI and its Shadow Arcs, whose deceptive win-lose strategies threaten both people and planet. You are called to become a game-changing Solutionary. Use your deck to outwit Moloch, reclaim stolen time, and help restore the legendary Elowyn Tree of Life—guardian of our planet and key to unlocking a new era.

Your gameplay also helps train benevolent AIs for a thriving future and supports regeneration projects that protect endangered species and critical bioregions.
